newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse freezes Acoje price rise.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse freezes Acoje price rise.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) on Monday froze the share price of Acoje Holdings Inc in mid-morning trade after it gained eight centavos, or 48.48 percent, to 25 centavos.
The bourse automatically freezes a share price if it rises close to 50 percent or goes down by 40 percent within a single trading day.
Acoje shares can only be traded at 24.5 centavos or below, the PSE surveillance department said.
Acoje was converted last year from an oil exploration company into a holding firm.
Traders said Acoje shares may have risen on talk of a foreign firm buying into the company through the stock market.
An Acoje official who asked not to be named said that there was no buy-in but could not explain the sharp rise in Acoje price.
By mid-morning, a total of 40.67 million Acoje shares were being traded.
